privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: LaSu helps you learn languages from the text you already read online. Your data is yours, and we keep the practices around it short enough to actually read.
privacyPage.dataBody: LaSu only processes the specific text you highlight or select on web pages. We do not collect or monitor your browsing history, personal identifiers, financial information, or precise location data.
privacyPage.aiBody: To provide high-quality translations, your selected text is sent securely to our servers and then to third-party AI providers such as OpenAI.
privacyPage.aiAnonymityBody: we do not send your name or account details to AI providers.
privacyPage.aiPurposeBody: that data is used only to generate the translation you requested.
privacyPage.aiHistoryBody: translations are saved to your personal history so you can review and practise them later.
privacyPage.storageBody: Settings such as your target languages, register and UI preferences are stored on your device so the experience carries between sessions. Signed-out translations never leave your browser.
privacyPage.securityBody: All data in transit is protected with HTTPS. LaSu does not sell your data to advertisers, and we only share selected text with our AI sub-processors to deliver the core service.
privacyPage.rightsBody: You have full control over your learning data. Clear your translation history, change your community visibility or reset your preferences at any time inside the app.
privacyPage.contactBody: Questions about how we handle your data? Write to
